question: Do the v6-selected attention9 heads 1+4 jointly convert the weight-defined MLP8 post-cue complement into shared Q8 on a construction- and occupation-disjoint capable v10 bank?

frozen_design.population: Exactly the 13 A1 and 14 A2 v10 rows listed as jointly capable by the capability-only manifest.
frozen_design.actuation: Recompute the zero-fit MLP8 post-cue hidden-product component orthogonal to row(S^T W_Down) for each new pair and install it in base.
frozen_design.removals: Remove H1, H4, H1+H4, or all nine attention9 heads by restoring their native-base pre-c_proj response at every causal position.
frozen_design.target: The frozen temporal-Q8 projection of the released is/was selective axis supplies an independent final-state and answer-margin target; it never selects a head.

predictions.pred_a_authority_manifest_replay_self_cl: All hashes, exact manifest IDs, source partition, native self-clamp, finiteness and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_indirect_complement_route_transfe: Live complement behavior has target cosine at least 0.85 and mean absolute effect at least 0.05 in both panels; final-Q8 coordinate cosine is at least 0.70.
predictions.pred_c_h1h4_union_closes_attention9_conv: Relative to all-head removal, H1+H4 retains at least 0.75 absolute behavior and Q8 norm in both panels, with removed-effect and removed-Q8 cosine at least 0.90.
predictions.pred_d_both_heads_are_positive_material_: Each singleton removes at least 0.10 absolute behavior and 0.10 Q8 norm with positive signed behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_weight_defined_interface: No v10 outcome fits a subspace, mode, head, coefficient, or gain; there are no gradients or updates.

decision: Screen freezes H1+H4 as the transferable converter and licenses exact source pattern/value plus c_v/c_proj tensor compilation. Null retains attention9 as a module-level converter without a stable two-head program.
